rows.heading: Mandatory North-East / Hard Station Tenure
rows.quote_snippet: 6.3 Incentives & Allowances: Officers serving in Category 'C' North-East and hard stations are entitled to Special Hard Station Allowance (10% of BP), retention of family accommodation at the last station, additional casual leave, and subsidized travel concession (STC) per TA Regulations.
